snippet.title: Pre-order Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light, Drops February 27th
snippet.description:
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light explodes onto iOS & Android, Feb 27th!
🧩 Puzzle, platform and twin-stick blast your way through the Mexican jungle — solo or co-op!
🍏 Pre-order on Apple: apps.apple.com/app/lara-croft-guardian-of-light/id6502455111
🤖 Pre-register on Google: play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.feralinteractive.laracroftgol_android&pli=1

#LaraCroft #TombRaider #GuardianofLight @feralinteractive
